description: This is a JUnit test class for the FormService component in the OpenMRS medical record system. It contains tests for creating, updating, deleting, duplicating, and retrieving forms, form fields, form resources, and related entities within the OpenMRS API. The file also includes setup methods, mock data creation, and various assertions to verify the correct behavior of form-related functionalities.

classes.name: FormServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the functionality of FormService in OpenMRS, covering form creation, update, deletion, duplication, retrieval, resource handling, and security restrictions.

methods.description: Tests creation, update, retirement, unretirement, and deletion of a Form object.
